issues.description: Constructor parameter order mismatch for class Lecture: the problem statement and UML require the constructor to follow the attribute order from the UML (numberOfInscribedStudents, lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfTutors). The solution implementation instead declares the constructor as: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). This difference in parameter ordering for the same constructor signature will confuse students (they are instructed to follow the UML order) and can cause tests or usages that expect the UML order to fail or be misleading.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution constructor parameter order match the UML and problem statement. Change the solution signature to: public Lecture(int numberOfInscribedStudents, String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfTutors) and update the constructor body assignments accordingly (this preserves the educational intent that constructor parameters follow the UML order). Alternatively, if the solution's order is preferred, update the problem statement/UML to explicitly show and document that parameter order.
